description.en: A one-plugin index for dsh-fast-mode. Add this URL as an index source in Plugins → Discover.
description.zh: dsh-fast-mode 的单插件索引。在「插件 → 发现 → 索引源」里添加这个地址即可。

description.en: Per-conversation fast mode for multi-step tasks: batches independent tool calls and drops redundant steps. Pooled over 8 blocks and 128 valid paired runs: about 19% less total wall-clock time (0.809x, median 0.813x, 95% interval 0.734-0.894); 15-30% on the shapes it fits (codeimpl median 0.709x, shellpipeline 0.844x); hidden tests still passing.
description.zh: 单会话开关的快速模式：合并可并行的工具调用、减少冗余步骤。8 块 128 对有效配对的合池结果：整任务总墙钟约快 19 %（0.809×，逐格中位 0.813×，95% 区间 0.734–0.894）；适合的形状快 15–30%（codeimpl 中位 0.709×、shellpipeline 0.844×）；隐藏测试仍全绿。
